page_title: BAY 3-0 HOF | Bayern Munich v Hoffenheim 12/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
90+3' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.

90+3' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) dribbles deep into the box and releases a strike towards the left side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann makes a sensational reflex save and punches the ball onto the post. Superb goalkeeping! The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
90+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 0 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds himself in a very promising position after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and fires the ball inside the right post!
89' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a chip pass into the box, but Oliver Baumann is quickest to intercept the ball.
87' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Jamal Musiala and he is replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
85' What a chance that is! Joshua Kimmich swings the ball into the box, and Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post.
84' Substitution. Maximilian Beier is replaced by Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).
83' That's a clear yellow card. Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) goes into the book.
82' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

82' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
82' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
81' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
80' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.
80' An attempted cross from Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) is cleared. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
79' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Wout Weghorst.
79' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Andrej Kramaric will be replaced by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) will replace Marius Bulter.

78' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
78' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
78' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) replacing Konrad Laimer.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) replaces Raphael Guerreiro.
77' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
77' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Manuel Neuer easily deals with the threat.
76' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.
75' A pass from Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann and the move breaks down.
74' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) picks up his second yellow card from referee Benjamin Brand and is given his marching orders.
73' Here is a change. Leroy Sane is going off and Thomas Tuchel gives the last tactical orders to Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is coming onto the pitch as Thomas Muller cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
72' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) sent a pass onto Wout Weghorst, who didn't get a chance to finish.
70' 2 - 0 Goal! Leroy Sane tees up Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 2:0.
69' Alphonso Davies races towards the box before laying off to Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
67' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benjamin Brand who sees an offensive foul.
65' A great pass puts Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
64' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Manuel Neuer stops the ball from going inside right post.
64' The corner from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is hurriedly cleared.
63' Manuel Neuer makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) after a cross from the side. Hoffenheim have a corner.
62' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
62' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim). The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
61' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
60' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) takes it short.

60' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Oliver Baumann shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
58' What a shot! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) decides to unleash a long-range missile of a shot, but his effort smashes against the right post.
57' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
57' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

55' A neat pass is well received by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
54' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
52' Marius Bulter finds Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
50' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
49' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
48' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
47' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' The whistle blows and Benjamin Brand starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Oliver Baumann, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
42' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
41' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post!

39' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed low towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
38' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his low, long-range blast aimed directly at the bottom of the net.

37' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Oliver Baumann shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
37' The ball is cleared after Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.
35' Bayern Munich hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

30' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. A rebound falls kindly for Anton Stach (Hoffenheim), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!

30' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom left corner of the goal. Oliver Baumann displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

27' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
25' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) and Harry Kane attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
24' 1:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 1:0.
22' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
18' 1 - 0 Leroy Sane passes the ball into the penalty area. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
18' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a chance to score from a corner.
16' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
15' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
15' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
11' A pass from Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Manuel Neuer and the move breaks down.
10' Maximilian Beier passes to Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
9' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
6' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
4' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Leroy Sane, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
2' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.
2' Good defending. Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) tries to find Andrej Kramaric inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Benjamin Brand will supervise the game today.
